newsitem.title: USA: USWC crudes up with WTI, buyers sidelined by rumor.
newsitem.headline: USWC crudes up with WTI, buyers sidelined by rumor.

text.p: U.S. West Coast crude prices rose with West Texas Intermediate (WTI) Monday while differentials stayed flat as traders tried to find out if a sale of Alaskan crude went unrecorded last week.
Several West Coast crude traders heard a cargo of Alaska North Slope (ANS) crude sold at a larger discount than the $1.05 done Friday.
BP, the main ANS producer, denied it sold the cargo.
Buyers also waited to see if Canadian crude would be diverted West following the shutdown of major pipelines into the Midwest states.
